今天：2026-08-19
ADR-009：Quill 協作編輯器的同步引擎更換
所屬專案：Quill（企業內部文件協作編輯器）　決策狀態：Accepted　日期：2026-08-14
參與者：前端架構 Aaron、後端 Betty、PM 林家瑜、SRE Chris

背景
Quill 原訂 9/1 對全公司開放 Beta，核心功能是多人同時編輯同一份文件，目前以 Yjs 作為 CRDT 同步引擎。7 月底的壓力測試發現兩個問題：(1) 50 人以上同時編輯一份長文件時，瀏覽器記憶體會漲到 2GB 以上；(2) 我們自行實作的離線合併在表格結構上會產生重複列，已有 14 個重現案例，社群也有人回報同樣問題，但還沒有修正。

考慮的選項
1. 繼續用 Yjs，自行修補表格合併：Aaron 評估修補要深入內部資料結構，風險高，未來升級也困難。
2. 改用 Automerge 2.x：記憶體表現較好，表格以 list-of-maps 表示可以避免重複列，但 API 差異大，編輯器綁定層要重寫。
3. 改成以伺服器為中心的 OT（operational transform）：要重寫後端並放棄離線編輯，不符需求。

決策
採用選項 2，以 Automerge 取代 Yjs。

後果
- 編輯器綁定層與離線儲存要重寫，Aaron 估計 3 週；Betty 的後端同步服務也要調整約 1 週，可以並行。
- Beta 開放日由 9/1 改為 9/22，林家瑜已在 8/15 通知各部門的試用窗口。重寫已經開工，第一版綁定層預計 8/28 進入內部測試。
- 舊的 Yjs 文件格式需要轉換工具，由 Betty 負責，Beta 前完成。
- Beta 的功能範圍不變，仍包含表格、留言與版本紀錄。

附註
- 與本 ADR 無關：設計系統組的「Icon 元件庫 3.0」已取消，Quill 繼續沿用 2.x 版圖示。
- 下次架構會議將討論 Quill 的權限模型是否改接 Okta 群組。

Today: 2026-10-19
Cross-team product report, October cycle (published Monday 19 October 2026). Lead project for this report: Juniper Learning Paths, the adaptive course-sequencing feature for the Corvid LMS; other teams appear in the appendix.

Context
Juniper Learning Paths was approved in March to recommend the next module to each learner based on quiz results. The original plan was a closed beta with three university customers in November and general availability in January. The team is Noor Haddad (PM), Kenji Watanabe and Sofia Brandt (backend), Felipe Ortiz (data science) and Grace Mwangi (UX research).

Research findings
Grace completed twelve interviews with instructional designers in September. The headline is that instructors want control over sequencing rather than automatic recommendations; nine of twelve said they would switch automated paths off by default. Felipe's offline evaluation showed the recommendation model beat the static syllabus order on completion rate by only 1.4 points, inside the noise band.

Steering decision
At the portfolio review on October 14, the steering committee, chaired by the VP of Product, reviewed these results together with the cost of the three-customer beta. The committee voted to end Juniper Learning Paths: the beta will not run, the January release is withdrawn from the roadmap, and the recommendation service will not be deployed to production. Noor informed the three beta customers on October 16, and all three acknowledged. Kenji and Sofia move to the Gradebook squad from October 26; Felipe joins the analytics platform group.

What happens to the work already done
The quiz-result event stream that Kenji built will be kept, because the Gradebook squad can reuse it for late-submission reporting. The recommendation model and its feature store will be archived in read-only form for six months and then deleted. Grace's interview synthesis is being published to the research wiki so other teams can use it.

Budget
Juniper had used 61 percent of its approved budget. The remaining 39 percent returns to the product pool and will be reallocated at the November planning session.

Appendix - other teams
- Gradebook squad: the weighted-category feature is two weeks behind because of a schema migration that needs a maintenance window; new target is December 4. The extra engineers from Juniper should help with the backlog of export bugs.
- Mobile app: the offline-download feature is blocked on Apple's review of the new background-transfer entitlement; the team has filed an appeal.
- Proctoring partnership: legal is still negotiating the data-processing agreement; work continues on the integration spec in the meantime.
- Accessibility audit: all 38 findings from the external audit are fixed and verified; the audit firm will reissue its letter next week.

Open questions for the next report
Finance asked whether the Juniper archive needs separate storage costs; Kenji estimates under 40 dollars per month. Customer success asked for a short FAQ for account managers who may be asked about adaptive paths; Noor will write it this week.
